title: 5-Lakh Travel Plan
footer: 5-lakh travel plan · Sri Lanka → Thailand → Malaysia · checked 6 Nov 2026

cover.kicker: From Pakistan · one traveller · PKR 5,00,000 all-in
cover.title:
3 countries, 13 relaxed days:
Sri Lanka → Thailand → Malaysia
cover.sub: The cheapest comfortable route we found for a Pakistani passport within 5 lakh, with every visa, document and booking step in the right order. Written for a gold business owner who has personal and business bank accounts and gold statements.

stats.l: one SriLankan Airlines booking, 30 kg bag

blocks.title: Why this route
items: **Cheapest visas:** Sri Lanka's tourist ETA is free for Pakistanis (since 25 May 2026). Thailand and Malaysia are both online applications. No interviews.
**One airline ticket** takes you out and home (Pakistan → Colombo → Bangkok … Kuala Lumpur → Colombo → Pakistan). That satisfies FIA's same-airline return-ticket rule.
**Halal food is easy** in all three countries, and there are mosques everywhere. You can pray Jumu'ah at Masjid Negara in Kuala Lumpur.
**No rushing:** never more than one flight every 4–5 days, no 1-night stops, no overnight buses.

blocks.title: The one rule that keeps you inside 5 lakh
blocks.text: Everything except the air ticket costs about **PKR 2.85 lakh**. So price the SriLankan ticket first (section 8). If it is **PKR 1.8 lakh or less**, do this 3-country plan. If it is more, do the **2-country plan** (Sri Lanka + Malaysia, 13 nights, ≈ PKR 4.4–4.5 lakh). A 4th country does not fit in 5 lakh.

cover.foot: Researched and fact-checked on 6 November 2026 against government visa portals, embassy pages, airline fare pages and 2026 news. Prices are estimates at **PKR 280 = USD 1**. Visa rules change, so re-check each official link the week you apply.

blocks.sub: Three countries, 13 days, one booking with SriLankan Airlines plus one short AirAsia flight.

head: Where
Nights
What you'll do
Visa
rows: Temple of the Tooth, Kandy Lake, Peradeniya gardens, a car day-trip to **Sigiriya Lion Rock** and **Dambulla cave temple**, Colombo's Red Mosque, Pettah market and Galle Face Green.
Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Wat Arun by river ferry, a day-trip to the ruins of **Ayutthaya**, Chinatown's gold street, halal food on Sukhumvit Soi 3.
Petronas Towers, Masjid Negara and the **Islamic Arts Museum**, Batu Caves, Putrajaya's mosques, shopping before the flight home.

cols.text: Best dates

rows: After Eid ul-Fitr (≈ 10 Mar) and before the 13–15 April New Year holidays in Sri Lanka and Thailand. Dry in Sri Lanka, hot in Bangkok and KL. Hotels are cheaper than in January. Gives you time to prepare calmly. **Example dates in this plan: Tue 23 Mar → Sun 4 Apr 2027.**
Best weather, but peak hotel prices, and only possible if you pay the Thai visa fee by about **20 November 2026**.
Ramadan (≈ 8 Feb – 9 Mar 2027), Eid weeks, 13–15 April, and May–September (monsoon in Sri Lanka, rain in Bangkok).

cols.text: Spending style this budget assumes

items: A **private room with AC and its own bathroom** in a guesthouse or 2-star hotel (USD 20–28 a night). No dormitories.
Mostly **local halal restaurants** (USD 9–13 a day).
Trains, buses, Grab and PickMe, plus **one private car day** in Sri Lanka.
Entry tickets for every sight in the itinerary.
Not included: shopping, gifts and gold.

cols.title: Departing from Islamabad?
cols.text: SriLankan Airlines doesn't fly from Islamabad. Take the motorway bus to Lahore (≈ 4–5 h, ≈ PKR 3,000) and fly from there.

cols.title: Decision rule (do this before anything else)
items: Everything except the SriLankan ticket ≈ **PKR 2.85 lakh** (Karachi) or **2.9 lakh** (Lahore).
**Ticket ≤ PKR 1.8 lakh** → do this 3-country plan.
**Ticket above 1.8 lakh** → do the 2-country plan: **Sri Lanka 6 nights + Malaysia 7 nights** (KL + Penang). It costs about **PKR 4.4–4.5 lakh** and needs no Thai visa (section 12).
From Lahore, the 3-country plan usually comes out 5–20k over 5 lakh unless you find a sale fare. Either take the 2-country plan or use the 'Lahore lite' savings below.

cols.text: Savings, if you need them

rows: Bus from the airport to Kandy via Colombo instead of a private car (longer day)
One fewer night in Colombo (fly out on day 5)
Public bus to Sigiriya/Dambulla instead of the car day
Pay hotels in local cash at check-in where allowed (avoids the card's 4% FX fee). Malaysia must be prepaid.
Skip the Petronas Skybridge (towers are free to see from KLCC Park). It is not in the budget anyway.

blocks.title: Also keep in mind
items: **Show money is not spending money.** Thailand can ask to see **20,000 baht (≈ USD 600)** per person when you arrive. Carry about **USD 900 in cash** from Pakistan and keep USD 650 of it untouched until Bangkok immigration (section 9).
**Your bank balance must be much larger than the trip.** Visa officers want to see that you can afford the trip and still have money left. See section 4.

blocks.text: Step-by-step timeline: what to do, and when
blocks.sub: Weeks are counted back from departure. The example dates are for a Tue 23 March 2027 departure. Do the steps in this order: Thailand first because it is the slowest and strictest, then Malaysia, then Sri Lanka.

items.title: Check your passport
items.text: It must be valid at least **6 months after you come home** (so until at least October 2027) with **3+ blank pages** (Malaysia's rule). If not, renew it now: e-passport 36 pages, 5 years = Rs 9,000 (21 working days) or Rs 15,000 urgent (5 working days), paid cashless through Passport Fee Asaan. Keep your old passports; they show your travel history.

items.title: Fix your tax and bank profile
items: Check you are on FBR's **Active Taxpayer List** at iris.fbr.gov.pk (Verifications). Filers pay half the card tax and look much stronger to visa officers.
Keep a **steady personal balance** for the coming months and avoid big one-off deposits. Move money from the business account as regular monthly drawings (section 4).
Ask your bank for: a **12-month personal statement** (stamped and signed), a **business account statement**, and an **account maintenance certificate** for each.

items.title: Collect your business documents
items.text: NTN certificate, last 2 years of FBR returns with wealth statement, chamber of commerce or sarafa/jewellers' association certificate, shop rent agreement or ownership papers, and a gold valuation certificate. Get English translations of anything in Urdu. Full list in section 4.

items.title: Polio drops + NIMS certificate
items.when: T−10 to T−5 weeks · Jan–mid Feb
items.text: Get the free oral polio dose at a government hospital, EPI centre or District Health Office (bring CNIC and passport). Then download the certificate at **nims.nadra.gov.pk** (≈ Rs 100). The dose must be **4 weeks to 12 months** before you fly. Don't rely on the airport counter.

items.title: Get the airline quote and decide: 3 countries or 2
items.text: Price the SriLankan multi-city ticket (section 8). Apply the decision rule in section 2. Book it, and ask the call centre (+94 11 777 1979) what a date or route change costs. Multi-city bookings can't be changed online.

items.title: Book AirAsia Bangkok → KL and all hotels
items.text: Buy the AirAsia ticket with a 20 kg bag. Book every night: Bangkok and Sri Lanka with free cancellation, **Kuala Lumpur prepaid** (Malaysia asks for proof of PAID accommodation). Use only real bookings; fake or 'held' bookings mean refusal.

items.title: Apply for the Thailand e-Visa and pay the fee
items.text: Apply on thaievisa.go.th, then pay PKR 13,000 in cash at the Visa Gate the next working morning (section 5). Stay in Pakistan until it is approved, about 14 working days after the fee is received. **Print it.**

items.title: Apply for the Malaysia eVISA
items.text: On malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my (section 6). It takes 2–7 working days and is valid for 6 months, so applying early is safe. Print the eVISA Note.

items.title: Apply for the free Sri Lanka ETA
items.text: On eta.gov.lk, 2–4 weeks before you fly (section 7). The fee should show **zero**. Print the approval.

items.title: Buy insurance; sort money and SIM
items.text: Buy EFU (or similar) insurance in Pakistan before the trip starts. Buy about USD 900 from a licensed exchange company (keep the receipt). Switch on international use for your debit card. Pack (section 9).

items.title: Optional: visit the FIA facilitation desk
items.text: FIA zonal offices in Lahore and Karachi run pre-departure facilitation desks (9 am–5 pm, every day). They check visas, return ticket and cash limits. Re-check any new FIA rules.

items.title: Print everything and pack your FIA folder
items.text: Two printed copies of every visa, ticket and hotel booking, plus PDFs on your phone. The Thai e-Visa **must be on paper**.

items.title: Fly
items.text: Be at the airport **4 hours early**. Declare your USD cash and any jewellery to Customs (section 10).

items.title: Two online arrival cards during the trip
items: **Thailand TDAC**, free, within 72 hours before landing in Bangkok: tdac.immigration.go.th. Do it on Day 4 or 5.
**Malaysia MDAC**, free, within 3 days before landing in KL (submission day counts): imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. Do it on Day 8–10.

blocks.sub: Prepare one file and use it for all three visas and for FIA at the airport. Get bank papers stamped and signed, and dated within about 2 weeks of each application.

cols.title: Money and tax
items: **Personal bank statement, last 12 months** (Thailand asks for at least 1 year; Malaysia for 3 months)
**Account maintenance certificate** from the bank (name, CNIC, account number, opening date, current and average balance)
**Business bank statement, 6–12 months** + its maintenance certificate
**NTN certificate** (print from FBR IRIS)
**FBR income tax returns + wealth statement**, last 2 years, with IRIS acknowledgement
**ATL printout** (Active Taxpayer List status)

cols.title: Business and ties to Pakistan
items: Business registration: NTN in the business name, STRN if any, partnership deed or SECP papers
**Chamber of commerce** and/or **sarafa / jewellers' association** membership certificate
Shop rent agreement or ownership papers (translated into English if in Urdu)
**Letter on your business letterhead** (signed, stamped): you are the owner since [year]; the business runs normally under [manager] while you travel; your travel dates; the date you resume work
Business cards
Optional: **Family Registration Certificate** (NADRA) to show family ties

cols.title: Identity and travel
items: Passport (6+ months valid after return, 3+ blank pages) + old passports
2 copies of CNIC; 2 copies of passport bio page and any previous visas
Photos: **35 × 50 mm, white background, studio, taken within 6 months, no cap** (Malaysia's rule; also fine for Thailand). Keep a digital file under 2 MB.
**Proof of address** in your name matching your CNIC (utility bill or rent agreement); Thailand requires it
SriLankan e-ticket, AirAsia ticket, hotel bookings, insurance, NIMS polio certificate
**Cover letter** (template in section 13)

cols.title: How to use your gold statements
items: Embassies judge **money in the bank**, not gold. No official checklist accepts gold in place of a bank statement. Gold shows you are wealthy and have reasons to come back; it is **supporting evidence only**.
The strongest proof of gold is your **FBR wealth statement** showing it, year after year.

Add an **independent valuation certificate** (bank-approved gold appraiser or your jewellers' association, not your own shop). It should give weight, karat, rate used, total value, valuer's name, stamp and date.
Upload it under 'other supporting documents' and mention it in one line of the cover letter.

cols.text: How much should be in the account?

rows: No official minimum for single entry (multiple entry needs > PKR 6.5 lakh for 6 months). Media and agents quote PKR 3.5–5 lakh.
No minimum; carry proof of funds.

Keep **PKR 7.5–10 lakh** steady in your **personal** account for 6+ months, about 1.5–2 times the trip cost. Then the trip money leaves a healthy balance behind. (Practical guidance, not an official rule.)

cols.title: Red flags that get visas refused
items: A **big deposit just before applying**, e.g. after selling gold. If you must, keep the sale invoice and make sure it matches your tax return.
Balance far bigger than the income on your tax return, or a large business turnover with an empty personal account
Not on the ATL / no tax returns
Business name or address different on the NTN, bank account and chamber certificate
Fake, 'dummy' or cancelled bookings. Thailand warns this means rejection and possible **blacklisting**.

blocks.sub: Do this first: it is the slowest, the strictest, and you must be in Pakistan for the whole process.

blocks.name: Thailand: Tourist Visa (TR), single entry
facts: PKR 13,000, cash at the mission, non-refundable
≈ 14 working days after the fee is received
Up to 60 days; enter within 3 months of issue
Islamabad embassy if you live in Punjab/KP/ICT; Karachi consulate if in Sindh/Balochistan
Printed e-Visa + TDAC + 20,000 baht or equivalent

steps.title: Book first, apply second.
steps.text: The embassy's checklist asks for a **confirmed, non-refundable air ticket** and accommodation. Upload your SriLankan e-ticket, the AirAsia Bangkok→KL ticket and your Bangkok hotel booking.

steps.title: Create an account on thaievisa.go.th
steps.text: Choose the mission where you live (Royal Thai Embassy Islamabad or Royal Thai Consulate-General Karachi), then **Tourist Visa (TR), single entry**.

steps.title: Fill the form and upload (JPG/PDF, max 3 MB each)
steps.text: Passport bio page, photo (within 6 months, matching how you look now), **proof of your current address in Pakistan**, tickets, hotel, 12-month bank statement + bank certificate, business letterhead letter, business registration papers (NTN, chamber/association), 2 CNIC copies, previous visas, cover letter. Add the gold valuation and wealth statement as supporting documents.

steps.title: Print the application confirmation and pay in cash
steps.text: Islamabad: at the embassy **Visa Gate**, Monday–Friday mornings (about 09:30–13:00), in person or through a trusted relative. Karachi: follow the consulate's payment instructions on its website. **Do not pay fixers**; the embassy warns against them.

steps.title: Wait in Pakistan (≈ 14 working days)
steps.text: You must stay in Pakistan until the decision. Embassy holidays add days.

steps.title: Print the e-Visa (2–3 copies)
steps.text: Phone copies are NOT accepted at check-in or at Thai immigration.

steps.title: Within 72 hours before your Colombo → Bangkok flight
steps.text: Fill the free **Thailand Digital Arrival Card** at https://tdac.immigration.go.th (avoid look-alike sites that charge).

docs: Onward AirAsia ticket and SriLankan ticket home
**20,000 baht (≈ USD 600) in cash or equivalent**, which officers may ask to see
blocks.warn: If Thailand refuses: you lose the PKR 13,000 fee. Switch to Plan B in section 12 (Sri Lanka + Malaysia). Ask SriLankan to change your Colombo → Bangkok flight to Colombo → Kuala Lumpur.

blocks.sub: Apply after the Thai approval, about 3–5 weeks before you reach KL.

blocks.name: Malaysia: eVISA, Social visit (VTR), single entry
facts: https://malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my (only), or the official MyVISA app
RM20 visa + RM105 processing + 0.8% card fee ≈ RM126 (≈ PKR 9,000)
2–7 working days (apply at least 14 days before)
Up to 30 days; one entry; use within 6 months of issue
eVISA Note + MDAC + paid hotel + return ticket

steps.title: Register on malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my
steps.text: Choose eVISA → Social → **Visa Without Reference (VTR)**, single entry. You can't apply from inside Malaysia, so do it from Pakistan.

steps.title: Check your photo with the official photo checker
steps.text: 35 × 50 mm, white background, studio photo taken in the last 6 months, no cap or headgear, no selfie or scan, max 2 MB.

steps.title: Upload
steps.text: Passport bio page; your **whole itinerary as one PDF** (SriLankan ticket + AirAsia ticket); **paid** KL hotel voucher; **last 3 months' bank statements** (personal + business merged into one PDF); a short cover letter (optional but useful).

steps.title: Check the total on the payment screen, then pay
steps.text: It should be about RM126. Some 2026 websites claim RM200; the official fee table still shows RM20 for Pakistan.

steps.title: Download and print the eVISA Note
steps.text: Don't apply twice: a new approval cancels the old one.

steps.title: Within 3 days before arriving (counting today)
steps.text: Fill the free **Malaysia Digital Arrival Card** at https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. Last port of embarkation: Bangkok.

docs: USD 300–500 in cash + a working card
blocks.warn: Malaysia's border agency has turned back Pakistani travellers at KLIA ('Not To Land') for fake hotel bookings, no return ticket or too little money (2025). Have every paper ready and answer simply: tourism, 3 nights, hotel name, flying home on [date].

blocks.sub: The easiest one. Do it last, 2–4 weeks before you fly.

blocks.name: Sri Lanka: Tourist ETA (free for Pakistan)
facts: 30 days, double entry within those 30 days
Within 3 months of the ETA being issued

steps.title: Open eta.gov.lk → Apply → Tourist ETA (individual)
steps.text: Look-alike agent sites charge USD 20–100 for this free ETA.

steps.title: Type your details exactly as in your passport
steps.text: Occupation: business owner (gold/jewellery). Purpose: tourism. Arrival: Colombo (BIA). Address: your Kandy hotel. Mistakes can't be corrected later; you'd have to apply again.

steps.title: The fee must show zero
steps.text: If you see a payment page, check you are really on eta.gov.lk.

steps.title: Save the reference number; print the approval email
steps.text: Track status on the site or the 24/7 helpline.

steps.title: Re-check the free scheme before applying
steps.text: Press reports say it was approved for one year (to about May 2027). A March 2027 trip is inside that, but check the site.

docs: SriLankan ticket showing your onward flight
Proof of funds (cash, card, bank statement)
blocks.warn: Sri Lanka Customs: declare personal gold jewellery and foreign cash at the 'Arrival No. 1' Customs officer. Gold bars and biscuits are not allowed as passenger baggage.

cols.text: The SriLankan Airlines ticket (one booking)

items.title: Go to srilankan.com → Book → Multi-city
items.text: Enter 4 flights:
items: Lahore or Karachi → **Colombo** (Day 1)
Colombo → **Bangkok** (Day 6)
Kuala Lumpur → Colombo (Day 13)
Colombo → Lahore or Karachi (Day 13, same day)

items.title: Check the price and the fare rules
items.text: Some cheapest fares don't allow a stopover in Colombo. If the website won't price it, call SriLankan (+94 11 777 1979) or a Pakistani IATA agent. Lahore flies about 4 times a week (check the days).

items.title: Check baggage
items.text: Economy is normally **30 kg + 7 kg cabin**. Confirm it on the fare.

items.title: Never skip the first flight
items.text: The rest of the ticket will be cancelled.

cols.text: Snapshot fares on srilankan.com (6 Nov 2026, round trips, no stopover): Karachi–Bangkok from PKR 1,62,874; Karachi–Colombo 1,70,218; Karachi–KL 1,89,973; Lahore–Bangkok 1,86,670; Lahore–Colombo 1,87,577; Lahore–KL 1,95,173. A stopover ticket usually costs the same or a bit more.
AirAsia Bangkok → Kuala Lumpur

items: Book on airasia.com and **add the 20 kg bag at booking**. Compare with Batik Air on the same route.
AirAsia leaves from **Don Mueang (DMK)**, not Suvarnabhumi, and arrives at **KLIA Terminal 2**.
Your 30 kg SriLankan allowance applies again after KL, so **do your shopping in KL** (the last stop), not Bangkok.

cols.text: Hotels: where to stay

rows: Near the lake or Temple of the Tooth. Guesthouses USD 15–25.
Fort, Pettah or Kollupitiya (near Galle Face and the Red Mosque). USD 25–35.
Pratunam or Ratchathewi: near halal food, quieter than Sukhumvit Soi 3–11 (a nightlife area). USD 25–40.
Bukit Bintang, Chinatown or near Masjid Jamek. RM100–140 + RM10/night tourist tax. **Prepay.**

cols.text: Book on Booking.com/Agoda with **free cancellation** (except KL, which must be prepaid). Check the price includes taxes and service charge.

blocks.text: Before you fly: polio, money, insurance, SIM

cols.text: Polio certificate

items: WHO rules for Pakistan (extended from 21 Aug 2026): a polio dose **4 weeks to 12 months before** international travel, with proof.
The dose is **free** at government hospitals, EPI centres and District Health Offices. It is entered into NADRA's system.
Download and print the certificate at **nims.nadra.gov.pk** (about Rs 100 by card, JazzCash or Easypaisa).
Airlines and airport health desks may check it. Carry the printout and a phone copy.

cols.text: Travel insurance

**EFU 'Worldwide excluding USA, Canada, Australia & Japan'**, up to 21 days: Standard (USD 35k medical) PKR 3,350, or Gold (USD 70k) PKR 5,350. Buy it online while you are in Pakistan. Compare TPL and Adamjee. Pre-existing illnesses are not covered.
SIM cards (buy at the airport, with your passport)

items: **Sri Lanka:** Dialog Tourist SIM, LKR 1,399 for 20 GB, at the Dialog store just after Customs.
**Thailand:** AIS / TrueMove tourist SIM at Suvarnabhumi arrivals (roughly 299–599 baht).
**Malaysia:** U Mobile (≈ RM15 for 7 days) or CelcomDigi (≈ RM25) at the operator's own KLIA counter.
Keep your Pakistani SIM on so bank OTP messages arrive.

cols.text: Money: cash, cards, limits

items: **Carry about USD 900 in clean USD 50/100 notes**, bought from a licensed exchange company with your CNIC (keep the receipt). Keep USD 650 for Thai immigration, and change money as you go.

**Legal limits leaving Pakistan:** up to USD 5,000 per visit (USD 30,000 a year) in foreign currency. Declare it on the FBR **Pass Track** app or at the Customs desk. Pakistani notes: keep it to Rs 3,000 or less.
**Cards:** switch on international use in your banking app. Advance tax 236Y is 0.5% if you are on the ATL, 1% if not. Banks add about a 4% FX fee. The yearly card limit is USD 30,000.
Take **two cards from different banks**. Always choose to pay in **local currency** (say no to 'pay in PKR' at the machine).
Use ATMs inside banks or malls (card skimming is reported in Sri Lanka).

cols.title: Gold and jewellery: special rules for you
items: **Do not carry business gold, coins, bars, samples or loose stones** out of Pakistan. State Bank rules do not allow exporting gold.
Wear only **minimal personal jewellery** and **declare it to Pakistan Customs when leaving**, so you can bring it back without questions or duty.
Sri Lanka and Malaysia also want jewellery and dutiable items declared on arrival.
Buying gold abroad? Check Pakistan Customs' current baggage rules and duty **before** you buy, and declare it on return.
**Gem scams:** in Sri Lanka and Bangkok, tuk-tuk drivers take tourists to 'special' gem shops. Don't buy on impulse.

cols.text: Packing and dress

Temples (and the Grand Palace) need **shoulders and knees covered**; trousers and a shirt are fine, shoes come off. Bring a light jacket for Kandy evenings, an umbrella, comfortable walking shoes, a universal plug adapter and a small padlock.

blocks.sub: In 2025 more than 66,000 travellers were stopped ('offloaded') at Pakistani airports, mostly for weak or missing papers. A complete folder solves most of this.

cols.title: Your FIA folder (printed + on phone)
items: Passport + CNIC + old passports
Thai e-Visa, Malaysia eVISA, Sri Lanka ETA (printed)
**SriLankan e-ticket (one booking, shows your return home)** + AirAsia ticket
Hotel bookings for **every** night + this itinerary
Travel insurance certificate
NIMS polio certificate
Personal + business bank statements (stamped) and maintenance certificates
NTN / ATL printout, chamber or sarafa association certificate, business letterhead letter, business card
Currency declaration (Pass Track) + exchange receipt
**Arrive 4 hours early.** Since October 2026 there are extra document checks before immigration.
**Same-airline rule:** FIA asks visit-visa travellers to Bangkok and Malaysia for a return ticket on the same airline/booking (Oct 2024; still applied). Your single SriLankan booking meets it.
**No Protector stamp** is needed for tourists. Carry nothing that looks like job-hunting (no CVs, no job offers).
Answer simply and consistently: *'Tourism, 13 days, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Malaysia. I own a gold business in [city]. I return on [date].'*
**There is no paid 'FIA clearance'.** A fake WhatsApp service was exposed in October 2026. Ignore anyone offering 'setting'.
The FIA e-immigration app was not launched as of November 2026. Clearance happens at the airport.

cols.title: If you are offloaded
items: Stay calm and politely ask for the **written reason / a copy of the offloading proforma**. The Lahore High Court (May 2026) said reasons must be recorded and given.
Apply for review to the airport's Incharge Immigration / Deputy Director **within 7 days** (decision within 3 days), then the FIA Zonal Grievance Committee (decision within 10 days).
Complaints: **FIA helpline 1991**. Keep your boarding pass and tickets for refunds.

blocks.sub: Example dates: Tue 23 March → Sun 4 April 2027. Change them to your own dates; just keep the number of nights.

items.place: 🇵🇰 → 🇱🇰 Fly to Colombo, drive to Kandy
items.plan: SriLankan flight (≈ 4 h). Buy a Dialog SIM after Customs. Private car to Kandy (≈ 3–3.5 h, about LKR 16,000–17,000 / USD 50; book via your guesthouse, or use Uber/PickMe). If you land late at night, sleep near the airport in Negombo and drive next morning.

Morning: **Temple of the Tooth** (≈ LKR 1,500–2,000; light, modest clothes). Walk round Kandy Lake. Lunch at the **Kandyan Muslim Hotel** (since 1907). Afternoon: **Peradeniya Royal Botanic Gardens** (≈ LKR 3,540).

Leave at 6:00 by car with driver (agree an all-in price, about LKR 18,000–25,000). Climb **Sigiriya Lion Rock** at opening (show your original passport for the SAARC price, ≈ USD 20 instead of 35). Then the **Dambulla cave temple** (≈ LKR 3,000). Back by evening.

Jumu'ah in Kandy, then the **air-conditioned intercity bus** to Colombo (≈ 3.5–4 h, ≈ LKR 740). Trains from Colombo now stop at Peradeniya, not Kandy, because of cyclone damage, so the bus is simpler. Fri 26 Mar is Good Friday (holiday), so leave early. Evening at **Galle Face Green**. **Fill the Thai TDAC today or tomorrow** (within 72 hours of landing).

**Jami Ul-Alfar (Red) Mosque** and **Pettah market**. Sea Street, Colombo's jewellers' street, is next door: interesting for a gold trader, but don't buy on impulse. Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square. Optional instead: a day-trip by coastal train to **Galle Fort**.
Colombo → Bangkok Suvarnabhumi (≈ 3.5 h). Airport Rail Link into the city (≈ 45 baht), Thai SIM at arrivals. Evening: halal dinner (Sukhumvit Soi 3 'Soi Arab', or near your hotel).

**Grand Palace + Wat Phra Kaew** at 8:30 (500 baht; strict dress code; ticket also covers a Khon show within 7 days). Walk to **Wat Pho** (300 baht). Cross-river ferry to **Wat Arun** (200 baht) for sunset. Ignore anyone saying 'the palace is closed today', a classic scam.

Train from Krung Thep Aphiwat (≈ 1 h) or Hua Lamphong (≈ 2 h, ≈ 20 baht). Temple pass ≈ 300 baht (or 80 per temple). Hire a tuk-tuk or bicycle between the ruins. Back to Bangkok by evening. **Fill Malaysia MDAC from today.**
**Chinatown (Yaowarat)**: Bangkok's famous gold-shop street. **Haroon Mosque** (Bang Rak). Chao Phraya Express boat. MBK/Pratunam markets, but keep shopping light for the 20 kg AirAsia bag.

Grab to **Don Mueang** (≈ 400 baht). AirAsia to KLIA2 (≈ 2 h). Airport bus to KL Sentral (≈ RM15), or KLIA Ekspres (RM65; RM58.50 if booked online). Malaysian SIM at the airport. Evening: **KLCC Park** and the lit Petronas Towers.
**Jumu'ah at Masjid Negara** (National Mosque). Next door, the **Islamic Arts Museum** (RM20, open 9:30–18:00). Merdeka Square, Masjid Jamek, Central Market.

Morning: **Batu Caves** by KTM train (free; dress modestly). Afternoon: **Putrajaya** by KLIA Transit (RM16.60 each way): Putra Mosque, Iron Mosque, the lake. Evening: shopping (your 30 kg allowance is back). Optional: Petronas Skybridge (RM80–98, book a time slot, closed Mondays).

Airport bus or KLIA Ekspres to **KLIA Terminal 1** (SriLankan). Kuala Lumpur → Colombo (change planes; you don't leave the airport) → Lahore/Karachi. Declare any jewellery or purchases to Customs on arrival.

blocks.title: Prayer, food and safety on the way
items: **Halal logos:** HAC (Sri Lanka), CICOT (Thailand), JAKIM (Malaysia). Big chains in Sri Lanka and Malaysia are generally halal.
Use **PickMe/Uber** (Sri Lanka) and **Grab** (Thailand, Malaysia) instead of street taxis. Agree tuk-tuk fares first.
Avoid Thailand's far south and anywhere near the Thai–Cambodian border (both under travel warnings). This plan doesn't go there.

blocks.text: If something goes wrong: Plan B and Plan C

cols.text: Plan B: Sri Lanka + Malaysia (13 nights, ≈ PKR 4.4–4.5 lakh)
Use this if **Thailand refuses the visa**, or if the 3-country ticket costs more than PKR 1.8 lakh. It is also the most relaxed version.

items.title: Ticket
items.text: SriLankan: Lahore/Karachi → Colombo (stopover) → Kuala Lumpur, and KL → Colombo → home. If you already bought the 3-country ticket, call SriLankan to change Colombo→Bangkok into Colombo→KL (change fee + any fare difference).

items.title: Sri Lanka 6 nights
items.text: Kandy 3 (with the Sigiriya/Dambulla day), Colombo 2, plus 1 night at Galle or Negombo.

items.title: Malaysia 7 nights
items.text: KL 4 (as in this plan) + **Penang 3**: George Town heritage streets, Kapitan Keling Mosque, Penang Hill, nasi kandar (Penang's famous halal food). ETS train KL ↔ Butterworth, about 4 hours.

items.title: Visas
items.text: Sri Lanka free + Malaysia RM126. Malaysia's eVISA allows 30 days, but leaving and coming back needs a new eVISA, so stay inside Malaysia.

cols.text: Estimated: everything except the ticket ≈ PKR 2.45 lakh; ticket ≈ 1.95 lakh (Karachi) to 2.05 lakh (Lahore).
Plan C: Sri Lanka + Maldives (free visas)
If both Thailand and Malaysia fail, both of these visas cost nothing. The Maldives gives every nationality a free 30-day visa on arrival.

items: One SriLankan booking: Pakistan → Colombo (stopover) → Malé → Colombo → Pakistan.

Maldives rules: a **prepaid** booking at a registered guesthouse, a return ticket, enough money (carry at least USD 100 + 50 a day), and the free **IMUGA** declaration within 96 hours before landing (imuga.immigration.gov.mv).
Stay on a local island like **Maafushi** (guesthouses ≈ USD 50–80 a night after taxes). All food is halal; dress modestly; no public ferries on Fridays.
About **PKR 4.5–5 lakh** from Karachi for ~6 nights in Sri Lanka + 3–4 in the Maldives. Lahore costs more.

cols.text: Other problems

rows: Spend the 3 KL nights in Bangkok instead: change the SriLankan return to start from Bangkok, and cancel AirAsia.
Police report, then the Pakistan mission in that country (find the address on mofa.gov.pk before you go and save it).
Call your insurer's emergency number first. Keep every receipt.
Multi-city SriLankan changes are made by phone (+94 11 777 1979), not online.

blocks.title: Thinking ahead: building travel history
blocks.text: Clean trips with these easy visas (Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Thailand) help later applications. After 3–5 trips over 1–2 years, with filed tax returns and a steady bank history, a **Schengen, UK or US** visa becomes much more realistic. A valid one also unlocks the Turkey e-Visa and Georgia's e-visa. Never overstay, keep every boarding pass, and declare any past refusal honestly.

items: **1.** Read sections 1 and 2, then get the SriLankan Airlines quote. The decision rule in section 2 tells you whether to do 3 countries or 2.
**2.** Follow the timeline in section 3 **in order**. Each step points to the section with the details.
**3.** Tick the checklists as you go. Print sections 4, 10 and 11 and keep them in your hand luggage.
